title: How Many Macs Did Apple, Inc. Sell in Q1?
text:
With the New iMac Pro, Apple's Mac Momentum Looks Poised to Continue 
When Apple's (NASDAQ: AAPL) new iMac Pro was unveiled this summer, two things were clear: It was a beast, and it was expensive. With the space-gray iMac Pro finally launching this week, the new computer lives up to both of these expectations. Capable of sporting up to 18 cores and 22 teraflops of graphics performance, the iMac starts at a whopping $4,999. How Many Macs Did Apple, Inc. Sell in Q1? 
Apple's (NASDAQ: AAPL) iPhone business gets lots of attention from investors because of its sheer size. And the company's services and other products businesses are generating interest the tech giant's two fastest-growing segments. But another segment should be turning heads -- one that made a big comeback in Apple's fiscal 2017. We're talking Apple's Mac business.
